cards.name: Sudden Shock
cards.oracleText:
Split second (As long as this spell is on the stack, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.)
Sudden Shock deals 2 damage to any target.

cards.name: Sudden Disappearance
cards.oracleText: Exile all nonland permanents target player controls. Return the exiled cards to the battlefield under their owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Sudden Breakthrough
cards.oracleText:
Target creature gets +2/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn.
Create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")

cards.name: Sudden Edict
cards.oracleText:
Split second (As long as this spell is on the stack, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.)
Target player sacrifices a creature of their choice.

cards.name: Sudden Spoiling
cards.oracleText:
Split second (As long as this spell is on the stack, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.)
Until end of turn, creatures target player controls lose all abilities and have base power and toughness 0/2.

cards.name: Sudden Spinnerets
cards.oracleText: Target creature gets +1/+3 until end of turn. Put a reach counter on it. Untap it.

cards.name: Sudden Strength
cards.oracleText:
Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn.
Draw a card.

cards.name: Sudden Impact
cards.oracleText: Sudden Impact deals damage to target player equal to the number of cards in that player's hand.

cards.name: Sudden Death
cards.oracleText:
Split second (As long as this spell is on the stack, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.)
Target creature gets -4/-4 until end of turn.

cards.name: Sudden Insight
cards.oracleText: Draw a card for each different mana value among nonland cards in your graveyard.

cards.name: Sudden Setback
cards.oracleText: The owner of target spell or nonland permanent puts it on their choice of the top or bottom of their library.

cards.name: Sudden Reclamation
cards.oracleText: Mill four cards, then return a creature card and a land card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Sudden Salvation
cards.oracleText: Choose up to three target permanent cards in graveyards that were put there from the battlefield this turn. Return them to the battlefield tapped under their owners' control. You draw a card for each opponent who controls one or more of those permanents.

cards.name: Sudden Storm
cards.oracleText: Tap up to two target creatures. Those creatures don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps. Scry 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card on the bottom.)

cards.name: Sudden Demise
cards.oracleText: Choose a color. Sudden Demise deals X damage to each creature of the chosen color.

cards.name: Sudden Strike
cards.oracleText: Destroy target attacking or blocking creature.

cards.name: Sudden Substitution
cards.oracleText:
Split second (As long as this spell is on the stack, players can't cast spells or activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.)
Exchange control of target noncreature spell and target creature. Then the spell's controller may choose new targets for it.
